title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.318 - Added an optional `credential_expires_at` field to result messages: when the stored claude.ai sign-in in use ends - Added the `config_file_invalid` startup failure reason, reported when a configuration file read at startup isn't valid JSON - Fixed the interrupt response missing a message held behind a model change: it is now listed, cancelled with `cancel_queued`, and stopped at start-up as a queued message is - Changed `agentProgressSummaries`: while the subagent waits for a response on a likely-cold prompt cache, a summary can wait up to 5 minutes, and is not sent if the subagent ends first - Changed `status` in `PushNotificationInput` to optional - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.318 ## 0.3.317 - Added `onFailure` to hook matchers: with `"block"`, a hook that throws or returns invalid output blocks the action
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
